testcase.name: Scenario: Select a staged command with the secondary mouse button: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1213:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Select a staged command with the secondary mouse button ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And ribbon customization shows All Commands and an initially empty Part Tools target ✔ And "2D Sketches" has been staged in the target list ✔ When the user right-clicks the "2D Sketches" name in the target list ✔ Then the target row is highlighted ✔ And no context menu is visible ✔ When the user clicks the remove command button ✔ Then the target list is empty ✔ And "2D Sketches" is available in the source list ✔ And the target retains its pending-change marker ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And the Tools ribbon remains visible
